// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The other direction, and the one the owner warned about. SharedActivity is
// ours and carries nothing personal, but `copies` points at ActivityTemplate,
// which is a teacher's own work. Reading the relation rather than counting it
// turns a harmless content table into a route from ops into every teacher's
// activity library.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function libraryUptake() {
  return db.sharedActivity.findMany({
    select: { id: true, title: true, copies: true },
  });
}
